messages:
jen: Kicking off canary -> prod (v2.3.1) at 03:00-04:00 change window. Targeting 3% in eu-west. Release notes: small perf tweaks + kvcache fix. @naveen can you watch embeddings route?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout started: v2.3.1 -> prod (canary 3%). UI: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/1738456789

naveen: On it. Dashboards up, will watch p95 / embed latency and KV hit rate.

maya: quick heads up — seeing a small blip on embed-latency at ~t+40s, p95 +120ms. Not massive but trending upward.

ops-bot: ops-bot: ALERT: embedding-service (eu-west) p95 increased 15% vs baseline. Threshold breached.

sam: Recommend pausing and pinning back to v2.2.9 until we triage. Can we hold any further traffic?

jen: +1 to pause. @deploy-bot please pause-rollout and hold allocation. :hand:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Pausing rollout. Current canary remains at 3%.
To rollback: `deployctl rollback --to v2.2.9 --selector=canary`
To pin version: `deployctl pin-version --version=v2.2.9 --env=prod`

naveen: I'll pull instance logs and KV cache metrics now. If the kvcache patch is the culprit we should revert it.

maya: I can run smoke evals against the canary machines and validate outputs while you dig into metrics.

jen: Decision: pause + pin to v2.2.9 for safety. Sam, please prepare to rollback if pin confirmed. I'll update the change window thread and post an incident ticket if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Pin applied: prod pinned to v2.2.9. Rollout paused. Notifying on-call and updating release metadata.

sam: Initiating rollback now: `deployctl rollback --to v2.2.9 --force`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Traffic shifted back to v2.2.9, canary terminated. Created follow-up ticket INFR-1234 for postmortem.

jen: Thanks all. We'll hold here until kvcache patch is reverted and we have regression tests. @naveen please add a targeted eval and a KV hit-rate assertion to the rollout gate.
file_description: Canary started, anomaly detected, pause/pin/rollback coordination with deploy-bot and ops alerts
